svg.title: Clean and noisy audio with matching one-second detail
svg.desc: Waveform amplitude overview and a crop from 8 to 9 seconds. Both clips share the same scale; the noisy clip adds synthetic white noise at 10 dB whole-recording SNR. This is input evidence, not an accuracy result.
